01-01.headline: UNITED NATIONS DECLARATION SIGNED BY 26 ALLIED POWERS
01-01.description: Representatives of 26 nations pledge full resources against the Axis, establishing the foundation for post-war international cooperation.

01-20.headline: NAZI LEADERS CONVENE AT WANNSEE TO PLAN 'FINAL SOLUTION'
01-20.description: Senior German officials meet at a lakeside villa near Berlin to coordinate the systematic extermination of European Jewry.

01-27.headline: RED ARMY LIBERATES AUSCHWITZ DEATH CAMP
01-27.description: Soviet troops enter the gates of Auschwitz-Birkenau, discovering the full horror of the Nazi extermination programme. Thousands of survivors found in desperate condition.

01-30.headline: R.A.F. MOUNTS FIRST DAYLIGHT RAID ON BERLIN
01-30.description: Bomber Command strikes the German capital in broad daylight for the first time, disrupting a major Nazi rally on the anniversary of Hitler's rise to power.

02-02.headline: GERMAN SIXTH ARMY SURRENDERS AT STALINGRAD
02-02.description: Field Marshal Paulus capitulates after five months of savage fighting. Over 90,000 German troops taken prisoner in what is hailed as the turning point of the Eastern Front.

02-13.headline: ALLIED BOMBERS DEVASTATE DRESDEN IN MASSIVE FIRESTORM
02-13.description: Waves of British and American aircraft unleash incendiary bombing on the Saxon capital, creating a firestorm that engulfs the city centre.

02-15.headline: SINGAPORE FALLS TO JAPAN; 80,000 CAPTURED
02-15.description: Lt-Gen. Percival surrenders the supposedly impregnable fortress to General Yamashita. Churchill calls it the worst disaster in British military history.

02-19.headline: MARINES STORM BEACHES OF IWO JIMA
02-19.description: United States Marines assault the heavily fortified volcanic island in the Pacific. Fierce Japanese resistance expected from underground positions.

03-09.headline: TOKYO ABLAZE: 300 B-29S RAIN FIRE ON JAPANESE CAPITAL
03-09.description: The most devastating air raid in history kills an estimated 100,000 civilians as incendiary bombs create an unstoppable firestorm across 16 square miles.

03-07.headline: ALLIED TROOPS SEIZE BRIDGE AT REMAGEN; CROSS THE RHINE
03-07.description: American forces capture the Ludendorff Bridge intact, establishing the first Allied bridgehead across the Rhine and opening the road into the heart of Germany.

03-22.headline: PATTON'S THIRD ARMY CROSSES RHINE IN ASSAULT BOATS
03-22.description: General Patton leads his forces across the great river at Oppenheim, beating Montgomery's elaborate set-piece crossing by one day.

04-01.headline: AMERICAN FORCES INVADE OKINAWA IN LARGEST PACIFIC ASSAULT
04-01.description: Operation Iceberg lands 60,000 troops on the doorstep of Japan proper. The 82-day battle will prove the bloodiest of the Pacific campaign.

04-07.headline: JAPANESE SUPER-BATTLESHIP YAMATO SUNK EN ROUTE TO OKINAWA
04-07.description: The world's largest warship is overwhelmed by waves of American carrier aircraft. Over 3,000 crew perish in the one-way suicide mission.

04-12.headline: PRESIDENT ROOSEVELT DEAD; TRUMAN ASSUMES OFFICE
04-12.description: Franklin Delano Roosevelt, 32nd President of the United States and Commander-in-Chief through the darkest days of the war, dies of a cerebral haemorrhage at Warm Springs, Georgia.

04-15.headline: BRITISH TROOPS LIBERATE BERGEN-BELSEN CONCENTRATION CAMP
04-15.description: Soldiers of the 11th Armoured Division enter the camp to discover scenes of unimaginable horror. Tens of thousands of unburied dead and thousands more dying of typhus and starvation.

04-25.headline: AMERICAN AND SOVIET FORCES MEET AT ELBE RIVER
04-25.description: Patrols of the U.S. 69th Infantry Division link up with Soviet troops at Torgau, cutting Germany in two and symbolising the Allied pincers closing on Berlin.

04-28.headline: MUSSOLINI CAPTURED AND EXECUTED BY ITALIAN PARTISANS
04-28.description: The former Italian dictator and his mistress are shot near Lake Como while attempting to flee to Switzerland. Their bodies are hung from a petrol station in Milan.

04-30.headline: HITLER DEAD IN BERLIN BUNKER; DOENITZ NAMED SUCCESSOR
04-30.description: Adolf Hitler takes his own life as Soviet shells rain upon the Reichstag. Grand Admiral Doenitz assumes leadership of the crumbling Reich.

05-02.headline: BERLIN FALLS: SOVIET FLAG RAISED OVER REICHSTAG
05-02.description: After twelve years, the Thousand Year Reich comes to an end as Red Army soldiers plant the hammer and sickle atop the ruined German parliament.

05-07.headline: GERMANY SURRENDERS UNCONDITIONALLY; WAR IN EUROPE OVER
05-07.description: General Jodl signs the instrument of unconditional surrender at Reims. After five years, eight months and six days, the guns fall silent across the Continent.

05-08.headline: V-E DAY: EUROPE CELEBRATES END OF WAR
05-08.description: Millions take to the streets across the Allied nations. In London, vast crowds gather before Buckingham Palace as the King and Queen appear on the balcony with Mr Churchill.

06-04.headline: DUNKIRK EVACUATION COMPLETE: 338,000 TROOPS RESCUED
06-04.description: Operation Dynamo concludes after nine desperate days. A miraculous armada of warships, pleasure craft and fishing boats has snatched the B.E.F. from the jaws of annihilation.

06-06.headline: ALLIED ARMIES LAND IN FRANCE; D-DAY INVASION LAUNCHED
06-06.description: Under the supreme command of General Eisenhower, the greatest amphibious force ever assembled storms the beaches of Normandy. The liberation of Europe has begun.

06-22.headline: GERMANY INVADES RUSSIA; THREE MILLION TROOPS CROSS BORDER
06-22.description: Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa along a 1,800-mile front. The greatest military operation in history catches Stalin's forces utterly unprepared.

07-05.headline: GREATEST TANK BATTLE IN HISTORY BEGINS AT KURSK
07-05.description: Germany hurls 900,000 troops and 2,700 tanks against Soviet positions in a massive pincer attack. The Red Army lies in wait with deeply prepared defences.

07-10.headline: ALLIED FORCES INVADE SICILY; FIRST ASSAULT ON FORTRESS EUROPE
07-10.description: British and American troops land on the southern shore of Sicily in the largest amphibious operation yet mounted. The underbelly of Europe is breached.

07-20.headline: BOMB PLOT AGAINST HITLER FAILS; FUHRER SURVIVES
07-20.description: Colonel von Stauffenberg's briefcase bomb detonates in the Wolf's Lair but Hitler escapes with minor injuries. A bloody purge of the conspirators follows.

08-06.headline: ATOMIC BOMB DROPPED ON HIROSHIMA; CITY OBLITERATED
08-06.description: A single bomb of unprecedented destructive power has been released upon the Japanese city. President Truman warns of further atomic attacks unless Japan surrenders immediately.

08-09.headline: SECOND ATOMIC BOMB DESTROYS NAGASAKI
08-09.description: Three days after Hiroshima, a plutonium bomb devastates the port city. The Soviet Union simultaneously declares war on Japan and invades Manchuria.

08-14.headline: JAPAN SURRENDERS; SECOND WORLD WAR IS OVER
08-14.description: Emperor Hirohito broadcasts to the Japanese people for the first time, announcing acceptance of the Allied terms. Six years of global conflict come to an end.

08-15.headline: V-J DAY: WORLD CELEBRATES PEACE AT LAST
08-15.description: Jubilant crowds fill the streets of London, New York, Sydney and every Allied capital. After six years, the world is at peace.

09-01.headline: GERMANY INVADES POLAND; EUROPE ON BRINK OF WAR
09-01.description: German forces cross the Polish frontier at dawn. Luftwaffe bombers strike Warsaw and other cities without warning. Britain and France issue ultimatums to Berlin.

09-02.headline: FORMAL JAPANESE SURRENDER SIGNED ABOARD USS MISSOURI
09-02.description: In Tokyo Bay, Japanese representatives sign the instrument of surrender before General MacArthur and Allied commanders, formally ending the Second World War.

09-03.headline: BRITAIN AND FRANCE DECLARE WAR ON GERMANY
09-03.description: Mr Chamberlain broadcasts to the nation that a state of war exists. Air raid sirens sound over London within minutes. The Empire rallies to the cause.

09-07.headline: LONDON BLITZ BEGINS: LUFTWAFFE BOMBS CAPITAL
09-07.description: Waves of German bombers attack London's East End and docks in the first of 57 consecutive nights of bombing. Fires rage across the city.

09-17.headline: ALLIED AIRBORNE TROOPS DROP BEHIND ENEMY LINES IN HOLLAND
09-17.description: Operation Market Garden launches the largest airborne assault in history. Paratroopers seize bridges at Eindhoven and Nijmegen but face fierce resistance at Arnhem.

10-14.headline: ROMMEL FORCED TO TAKE POISON AFTER PLOT AGAINST HITLER
10-14.description: Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, the legendary Desert Fox, is given the choice of suicide or public trial. He takes cyanide to protect his family.

10-20.headline: MACARTHUR RETURNS TO THE PHILIPPINES AS PROMISED
10-20.description: General Douglas MacArthur wades ashore at Leyte, fulfilling his famous pledge made two and a half years ago. Liberation of the islands begins.

10-23.headline: MONTGOMERY LAUNCHES ATTACK AT EL ALAMEIN
10-23.description: The Eighth Army opens a massive artillery barrage against Rommel's positions in the Egyptian desert. The battle that will turn the tide in North Africa has begun.

11-08.headline: ALLIED FORCES LAND IN NORTH AFRICA; OPERATION TORCH BEGINS
11-08.description: Anglo-American forces under General Eisenhower storm ashore at Casablanca, Oran and Algiers. Vichy French resistance is expected to be brief.

11-19.headline: RED ARMY LAUNCHES MASSIVE COUNTER-ATTACK AT STALINGRAD
11-19.description: Operation Uranus smashes through Romanian positions on both flanks, threatening to encircle the entire German Sixth Army in the ruined city.

12-07.headline: JAPAN ATTACKS PEARL HARBOR; AMERICA AT WAR
12-07.description: Carrier-based aircraft strike the U.S. Pacific Fleet at anchor in Hawaii. Battleships Arizona and Oklahoma destroyed. Congress declares war with but one dissenting vote.

12-16.headline: GERMANS LAUNCH SURPRISE OFFENSIVE IN THE ARDENNES
12-16.description: Three German armies smash through thinly held American lines in the Belgian forest. The Battle of the Bulge threatens to split the Allied front in two.

12-25.headline: HONG KONG FALLS TO JAPAN ON CHRISTMAS DAY
12-25.description: After 18 days of fierce resistance, the British colony surrenders. Governor Sir Mark Young orders the garrison to lay down arms.

12-26.headline: ROYAL NAVY SINKS SCHARNHORST IN ARCTIC BATTLE
12-26.description: The German battlecruiser is destroyed off the North Cape of Norway by HMS Duke of York and escorting destroyers. Only 36 of her 1,968 crew survive.
